ko.title: 알고리즘에 전력을 공급하다: AI 데이터 센터가 전기 요금 청구서에 등장하는 이유

segments.src: For years, the electric grid in the United States was a quiet story.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 미국의 전력망은 조용한 이야기였습니다.

segments.src: Demand grew slowly, efficiency gains offset new gadgets, and utilities planned around flat or modestly rising load.
segments.tr: 수요는 천천히 증가했고, 효율성 향상이 새 기기들의 소비 전력을 상쇄했으며, 전력 회사들은 전력 부하가 평탄하거나 완만하게 상승하는 상황에 맞춰 계획을 세웠습니다.

segments.src: That picture is changing.
segments.tr: 그 그림이 바뀌고 있습니다.

segments.src: A surge of large data centers, driven in part by artificial intelligence, is pushing utilities to plan for demand growth on a scale many have not seen in a generation.
segments.tr: 인공지능 등에 의해 촉발된 대형 데이터 센터의 급증은 전력 회사들로 하여금 한 세대 동안 보지 못했던 규모의 수요 증가에 대비하도록 압박하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The question now moving from industry conferences to public utility hearings is simple: who pays for the power plants and power lines needed to serve them?
segments.tr: 이제 업계 컨퍼런스에서 공공 전력 청문회로 옮겨간 질문은 간단합니다. 이 데이터 센터들에 전력을 공급하는 데 필요한 발전소와 송전선 비용은 누가 부담하는가?

segments.src: ## Why data centers are different
segments.tr: ## 데이터 센터가 다른 이유

segments.src: A conventional office building or factory has a predictable footprint.
segments.tr: 일반적인 사무용 빌딩이나 공장은 예측 가능한 전력 사용 규모를 가집니다.

segments.src: A modern data center campus can require tens or even hundreds of megawatts, and the largest planned projects are discussed in the gigawatt range, comparable to the output of a large power plant.
segments.tr: 현대적인 데이터 센터 캠퍼스는 수십 혹은 수백 메가와트(MW)를 요구할 수 있으며, 기획 중인 가장 큰 프로젝트들은 대형 발전소의 출력과 맞먹는 기가와트(GW) 단위로 논의됩니다.

segments.src: AI workloads add to this because the specialized chips used to train and run large models draw a lot of power and generate heat that must be removed with cooling systems.
segments.tr: AI 워크로드는 거대 모델을 학습시키고 실행하는 데 사용되는 특수 칩이 엄청난 전력을 소비하고 냉각 시스템으로 제거해야 하는 열을 발생시키기 때문에 이러한 부담을 더합니다.

segments.src: Just as important is the speed.
segments.tr: 속도 역시 그만큼 중요합니다.

segments.src: A data center can be built in a couple of years, while new transmission lines and generating plants often take much longer to plan, permit and construct.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터는 2~3년 만에 지어질 수 있는 반면, 새로운 송전선과 발전소는 계획, 허가 및 건설에 훨씬 더 오랜 시간이 걸리는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: That mismatch is at the heart of the current debate.
segments.tr: 이러한 불일치가 현재 논쟁의 핵심에 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How this connects to household bills
segments.tr: ## 이것이 가정용 요금 청구서와 연결되는 방식

segments.src: Most households do not pay for data center electricity directly, but they can be affected in several indirect ways:
segments.tr: 대부분의 가정이 데이터 센터 전력 비용을 직접 지불하지는 않지만, 다음과 같은 여러 간접적인 방식으로 영향을 받을 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Infrastructure costs.** Utilities recover the cost of new substations, transmission lines and generation through rates approved by state regulators. If that infrastructure is built largely to serve a few large customers, the question is how much of the cost is assigned to them and how much is spread across all customers.
segments.tr: - **인프라 비용.** 전력 회사는 주 규제 기관의 승인을 받은 요금을 통해 신규 변전소, 송전선 및 발전 설비 구축 비용을 회수합니다. 해당 인프라가 주로 소수의 대형 고객에게 전력을 공급하기 위해 건설되는 경우, 그 비용의 얼마만큼을 해당 고객에게 할당하고 얼마만큼을 전체 고객에게 분산시킬 것인가가 문제입니다.

segments.src: - **Wholesale market prices.** In regions with organized power markets, higher expected demand can raise the prices that generators receive for capacity, which can flow through to retail bills over time. Several grid operators have reported sharp increases in capacity auction results in recent years, with demand growth cited as one factor among others.
segments.tr: - **도매 시장 가격.** 조직화된 전력 시장이 있는 지역에서는 예상 수요가 높아지면 발전사가 용량(capacity)에 대해 받는 가격이 올라갈 수 있으며, 이는 시간이 지남에 따라 소매 요금으로 이어질 수 있습니다. 여러 전력망 운영자들은 최근 몇 년간 용량 경매 결과가 급등했다고 보고했으며, 주요 요인 중 하나로 수요 증가를 꼽았습니다.

segments.src: - **Fuel and supply costs.** Natural gas prices, aging plant retirements, extreme weather and supply chain constraints on equipment such as transformers also influence rates. Data centers are rarely the only cause of a price change, and attributing a specific bill increase to one source is difficult.
segments.tr: - **연료 및 공급 비용.** 천연가스 가격, 노후 발전소 폐쇄, 기후 변화, 변압기 같은 장비의 공급망 제약 등도 요금에 영향을 미칩니다. 데이터 센터가 가격 변화의 유일한 원인인 경우는 드물며, 특정 요금 인상을 단 하나의 원인 탓으로 돌리기는 어렵습니다.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: 여기서 주의할 점이 있습니다.

segments.src: Rates are shaped by many forces, and the size of the data center effect varies widely by region.
segments.tr: 요금은 많은 요인에 의해 결정되며, 데이터 센터 영향의 크기는 지역에 따라 크게 다릅니다.

segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.
segments.tr: 일부 전력 회사는 새로운 대형 고객이 더 많은 판매량에 고정비를 분산시킴으로써 실제로는 모두의 단가 비용을 낮출 수 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.
segments.tr: 반면 다른 이들은 예상된 수요가 실현되지 않을 경우, 남아있는 고객들이 사용되지 않는 자산에 대한 비용을 부담하게 될 수 있다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate
segments.tr: ## 규제 논쟁

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.
segments.tr: 주 공공기획위원회(State utility commissions)는 비용 문제에 답하기 위한 방법들을 시도하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: 여러 주에서 논의되거나 채택된 접근 방식은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.
segments.tr: 1. **대규모 부하 요금제(Large-load tariffs).** 초대형 고객을 위한 전용 요금제로, 프로젝트 규모가 축소될 경우 전력 회사를 보호할 수 있도록 최소 계약 기간과 최소 월간 요금을 설정하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.
segments.tr: 2. **사전 공약.** 개발자가 건설을 시작하기 전에 금융 보증을 제공하거나 전용 전력망 보강 비용을 지불하도록 하는 요구 사항입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 3. **계통 연계 대기열 개혁.** 단일 프로젝트가 여러 전력 회사에 동시에 제출되어 수요 예측을 부풀릴 수 있으므로, 투기성 요청을 걸러내기 위한 엄격한 규칙을 적용합니다.

segments.src: 4. **Flexibility programs.** Incentives for data centers to reduce or shift consumption during periods of grid stress, or to bring their own generation or storage.
segments.tr: 4. **유연성 프로그램.** 전력망 부하가 높은 기간 동안 데이터 센터가 소비를 줄이거나 분산하도록 유도하거나, 자체 발전 및 저장 장치를 갖추도록 하는 인센티브입니다.

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.
segments.tr: 소비자 옹호 단체들은 대체로 비용을 유발한 주체가 비용을 부담하도록 하는 규칙을 선호합니다.

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터 운영자와 많은 지방 정부 관계자들은 일자리, 세수 및 투자를 강조하며, 조건이 명확하고 예측 가능하다면 자신들의 몫을 기꺼이 부담하겠다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: ## Local politics
segments.tr: ## 지역 정치

segments.src: The debate is not only about rates.
segments.tr: 논쟁은 단지 요금에 관한 것만은 아닙니다.

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.
segments.tr: 대형 캠퍼스가 제안되는 지역사회에서 주민들과 관계자들은 재산세 수입 및 건설 일자리라는 이점과 토지 사용, 소음, 냉각용 용수 사용, 신규 송전선의 시각적 영향에 대한 우려를 비교 형량합니다.

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: 일부 지역에서는 데이터 센터 제안에 대한 용도 지역 지정 청문회와 카운티 투표가 더욱 치열해졌으며, 여러 주에서는 원래 이러한 시설을 유치하기 위해 설계되었던 세제 혜택을 재검토했습니다.

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## 새로운 전력 확보를 위한 노력

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: 수요를 충족하려면 단일 솔루션보다는 다양한 접근 방식의 조합이 필요할 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Natural gas plants,** which can be built relatively quickly and are being proposed in many regions, though they raise emissions and fuel price questions.
segments.tr: - **천연가스 발전소,** 비교적 신속하게 건설할 수 있어 많은 지역에서 제안되고 있지만 온실가스 배출 및 연료 가격 문제가 제기됩니다.

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **태양광, 풍력 및 배터리 저장 장치,** 신규 용량 추가의 큰 비중을 차지하지만 계통 연계 지연 및 일부 경우 정책적 불확실성에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **원자력 발전,** 기존 원자로의 수명 연장, 최근 폐쇄된 원전의 재가동, 소형 모듈식 원자로(SMR) 등 차세대 디자인에 대한 초기 단계 작업이 포함됩니다. 이는 안정적인 출력을 제공할 수 있지만 신규 건설이 느리고 비용이 많이 듭니다.

segments.src: - **Efficiency and demand flexibility,** including more efficient chips and cooling, and scheduling flexible computing tasks for times when power is plentiful.
segments.tr: - **효율성 및 수요 유연성,** 더 효율적인 칩과 냉각 기술 도입, 전력이 풍부한 시간대로 유연한 연산 작업을 스케줄링하는 것을 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **전력망 업그레이드,** 전력이 아무리 풍부해도 이를 전달할 송전 용량이 없으면 소용이 없기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## 예측의 불확실성

segments.src: Forecasts for data center demand vary widely.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터 수요에 대한 예측은 크게 엇갈립니다.

segments.src: Efficiency improvements in AI hardware and software could slow growth, while new applications could accelerate it.
segments.tr: AI 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어의 효율성 향상은 성장을 둔화시킬 수 있는 반면, 새로운 애플리케이션의 등장으로 성장이 가속화될 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: 따라서 전력 회사와 규제 기관은 신뢰성을 위협하고 가격을 올릴 수 있는 과소 건설의 위험과, 필요하지 않은 용량에 대해 고객이 비용을 부담하게 만들 수 있는 과다 건설의 위험 사이에서 균형을 잡고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## 소비자가 할 수 있는 일

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **요금 청구서 및 요금제 구조 확인.** 고정 요금제인지 변동 요금제인지, 계절·시간대별 차등 요금제(TOU) 옵션이 자신의 생활 습관에 맞는지 파악하세요.

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **주 공공기획위원회 동향 주시.** 요금 인상 심사 및 대규모 부하 관련 절차는 공개되어 있으며, 대부분의 위원회는 고객의 서면 의견을 받습니다.

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **에너지 효율 프로그램 활용.** 많은 전력 회사가 단열 개선, 고효율 가전제품, 스마트 온도 조절기에 대한 환급금(리베이트)을 제공하며, 이는 요금 인상분을 상쇄하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Stay informed locally.** County and city meetings often decide where data centers are sited and what conditions apply.
segments.tr: - **지역 정보 파악.** 카운티 및 시 회의에서 데이터 센터의 위치와 적용 조건이 결정되는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.
segments.tr: AI 데이터 센터가 전기 요금이 뉴스에 나오는 유일한 이유는 아니지만, 국가가 새로운 에너지 인프라를 어떻게 계획하고, 비용을 부담하며, 승인하는지에 대한 핵심 시험대가 되었습니다.

segments.src: The decisions being made now by regulators, utilities and local governments will help determine whether the benefits and costs of this build-out are shared fairly.
segments.tr: 규제 기관, 전력 회사, 지방 정부가 지금 내리는 결정은 이러한 인프라 확충의 혜택과 비용이 공정하게 분담될지 여부를 결정하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: For households, the practical takeaway is to pay attention: the rules written in the next few years will shape the monthly bill for a long time.
segments.tr: 가정에서 기억해야 할 실용적인 시사점은 관심표명입니다. 향후 몇 년 동안 만들어지는 규칙이 오랫동안 매달 청구되는 요금을 결정할 것입니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not financial, investment or legal advice.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재무, 투자 또는 법률 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Rates and policies vary by state and utility; consult your local utility or regulator for details that apply to you.*
segments.tr: 요금 및 정책은 주 및 전력 회사에 따라 다르므로 귀하에게 적용되는 자세한 내용은 해당 지역 전력 회사나 규제 기관에 문의하십시오.*

zh.title: 驱动算法的背后：为什么 AI 数据中心会体现在你的电费账单上

segments.src: For years, the electric grid in the United States was a quiet story.
segments.tr: 多年来，美国的电网一直处于平稳发展状态。

segments.src: Demand grew slowly, efficiency gains offset new gadgets, and utilities planned around flat or modestly rising load.
segments.tr: 需求增长缓慢，效率提升抵消了新电子设备带来的消耗，电力公司规划的负荷也基本持平或仅有小幅上升。

segments.src: That picture is changing.
segments.tr: 这种情况正在发生改变。

segments.src: A surge of large data centers, driven in part by artificial intelligence, is pushing utilities to plan for demand growth on a scale many have not seen in a generation.
segments.tr: 在人工智能等因素的推动下，大型数据中心的激增正在促使电力公司制定许多人一代人未曾见过的规模化的电力需求增长规划。

segments.src: The question now moving from industry conferences to public utility hearings is simple: who pays for the power plants and power lines needed to serve them?
segments.tr: 如今，从行业会议转移到公用事业听证会上的问题很简单：为满足这些数据中心需求所需建立的发电厂和输电线路，究竟该由谁来买单？

segments.src: ## Why data centers are different
segments.tr: ## 为什么数据中心有所不同

segments.src: A conventional office building or factory has a predictable footprint.
segments.tr: 传统办公楼或工厂的用电规模是可预测的。

segments.src: A modern data center campus can require tens or even hundreds of megawatts, and the largest planned projects are discussed in the gigawatt range, comparable to the output of a large power plant.
segments.tr: 而一个现代化的数据中心园区可能需要数十甚至数百兆瓦的电力，规划中最大的项目更是达到了吉瓦级别，堪比一座大型发电厂的输出功率。

segments.src: AI workloads add to this because the specialized chips used to train and run large models draw a lot of power and generate heat that must be removed with cooling systems.
segments.tr: AI 工作负载加剧了这一状况，因为用于训练和运行大型模型的专用芯片会消耗大量电力，并产生必须通过冷却系统排除的热量。

segments.src: Just as important is the speed.
segments.tr: 同样重要的还有建设速度。

segments.src: A data center can be built in a couple of years, while new transmission lines and generating plants often take much longer to plan, permit and construct.
segments.tr: 数据中心可以在几年内建成，而新的输电线路和发电厂往往需要更长的时间来进行规划、许可和建设。

segments.src: That mismatch is at the heart of the current debate.
segments.tr: 这种时间上的错位正是当前争议的核心所在。

segments.src: ## How this connects to household bills
segments.tr: ## 这与家庭电费账单有何联系

segments.src: Most households do not pay for data center electricity directly, but they can be affected in several indirect ways:
segments.tr: 大多数家庭并不直接为数据中心的用电付款，但他们可能会通过几种间接方式受到影响：

segments.src: - **Infrastructure costs.** Utilities recover the cost of new substations, transmission lines and generation through rates approved by state regulators. If that infrastructure is built largely to serve a few large customers, the question is how much of the cost is assigned to them and how much is spread across all customers.
segments.tr: - **基础设施成本。** 电力公司通过州监管机构批准的电价率来收回新变电站、输电线路和发电设施的成本。如果这些基础设施主要是为了服务少数大型客户而建，问题就在于有多少成本被分摊给这些大型客户，又有多少成本被平摊给所有客户。

segments.src: - **Wholesale market prices.** In regions with organized power markets, higher expected demand can raise the prices that generators receive for capacity, which can flow through to retail bills over time. Several grid operators have reported sharp increases in capacity auction results in recent years, with demand growth cited as one factor among others.
segments.tr: - **批发市场价格。** 在拥有组织化电力市场的地区，预期需求的增加可能会提高发电厂在容量市场上获得的价格，并随着时间的推移传导至零售电费账单上。近年来，多家电网运营商报告称容量拍卖结果急剧上升，而需求增长被列为原因之一。

segments.src: - **Fuel and supply costs.** Natural gas prices, aging plant retirements, extreme weather and supply chain constraints on equipment such as transformers also influence rates. Data centers are rarely the only cause of a price change, and attributing a specific bill increase to one source is difficult.
segments.tr: - **燃料和供应成本。** 天然气价格、老旧电厂退役、极端天气以及变压器等设备的供应链瓶颈也会影响电价。数据中心很少是价格变化的唯一原因，要将特定的电费上涨归因于单一来源是十分困难的。

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: 在此需要保持谨慎。

segments.src: Rates are shaped by many forces, and the size of the data center effect varies widely by region.
segments.tr: 电价受多种因素影响，数据中心带来的影响程度因地区而异。

segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.
segments.tr: 一些电力公司认为，新增的大型客户实际上可以通过将固定成本分摊到更多销量上，从而降低每个人的单位成本。

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.
segments.tr: 另一些人则警告称，如果预期的需求未能实现，剩余的客户可能会被迫为未被利用的资产买单。

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate
segments.tr: ## 监管层面的辩论

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.
segments.tr: 州公用事业委员会正在探索解决成本归属问题的方法。

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: 各州讨论或采用的方法包括：

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.
segments.tr: 1. **大负荷电价（Large-load tariffs）。** 针对超大型客户设立的特殊电价类别，有时带有最低合同期限和最低月度费用，以便在项目缩减规模时保护电力公司的利益。

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.
segments.tr: 2. **前期资金承诺。** 要求开发商在开工建设前提供财务担保或支付专用电网升级的费用。

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 3. **并网排队改革。** 制定更严格的规则以筛选出投机性申请，因为单个项目可能会同时向多家电力公司提交，从而虚增需求预测。

segments.src: 4. **Flexibility programs.** Incentives for data centers to reduce or shift consumption during periods of grid stress, or to bring their own generation or storage.
segments.tr: 4. **灵活性项目。** 激励数据中心在电网紧张期间减少或转移用电，或者自带发电/储能设备。

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.
segments.tr: 消费者权益倡导者通常支持“谁引发成本，谁付费”的规则。

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.
segments.tr: 数据中心运营商和许多地方官员则强调就业、税收和投资，并主张只要条款明确且可预测，他们愿意承担各自应付的份额。

segments.src: ## Local politics
segments.tr: ## 地方政治

segments.src: The debate is not only about rates.
segments.tr: 这场辩论不仅仅关乎电价。

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.
segments.tr: 在拟建大型园区的社区中，居民和官员在权衡财产税收入和建筑就业机会的同时，也在对土地使用、噪音、冷却用水以及新输电线路的视觉影响等担忧进行考量。

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: 在某些地区，关于数据中心提案的分区规划听证会和县级投票变得更具争议性，有几个州甚至重新审视了最初旨在吸引这些设施的税收优惠政策。

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## 对新电力供应的推动

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: 满足需求可能需要结合多种方法，而不是依靠单一解决方案：

segments.src: - **Natural gas plants,** which can be built relatively quickly and are being proposed in many regions, though they raise emissions and fuel price questions.
segments.tr: - **天然气电厂，** 其建设速度相对较快，已在许多地区被提出，尽管它们引发了碳排放和燃料价格的疑问。

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **太阳能、风能和电池储能，** 它们占新增容量的很大一部分，但面临并网延迟，在某些情况下还面临政策不确定性。

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **核能，** 包括延长现有反应堆的寿命、重启近期关闭的机组以及在小型先进设计方面开展早期工作。这些可以提供稳定的输出，但新建工程速度慢且成本高。

segments.src: - **Efficiency and demand flexibility,** including more efficient chips and cooling, and scheduling flexible computing tasks for times when power is plentiful.
segments.tr: - **效率和需求灵活性，** 包括更高效的芯片和冷却技术，以及将灵活的计算任务安排在电力充足的时段。

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **电网升级，** 因为如果没有输电能力将电力输送出去，即使再充沛的发电量也毫无用处。

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## 预测中的不确定性

segments.src: Forecasts for data center demand vary widely.
segments.tr: 对数据中心用电需求的预测差异很大。

segments.src: Efficiency improvements in AI hardware and software could slow growth, while new applications could accelerate it.
segments.tr: AI 硬件和软件的效率提升可能会放缓增长，而新的应用场景则可能会加速增长。

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: 因此，电力公司和监管机构正在权衡建设不足（这可能威胁供电可靠性并推高价格）与过度建设（这可能导致客户为不需要的容量买单）之间的风险。

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## 消费者可以做什么

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **检查你的账单和电价结构。** 了解你使用的是固定电价还是可变电价方案，以及分时电价选项是否适合你的用电习惯。

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **关注你所在州的公用事业委员会。** 费率审查和大负荷诉讼程序是公开的，大多数委员会都接受来自客户的书面意见。

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **利用节能项目。** 许多电力公司为房屋防风雨改造、高效家电和智能温控器提供补贴，这可以抵消部分电价上涨的成本。

segments.src: - **Stay informed locally.** County and city meetings often decide where data centers are sited and what conditions apply.
segments.tr: - **关注当地动态。** 县级和市级会议往往决定着数据中心的选址以及适用的约束条件。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.
segments.tr: AI 数据中心并不是电费成本成为新闻焦点的唯一原因，但它们已成为检验国家如何规划、支付和批准新能源基础设施的核心测试案例。

segments.src: The decisions being made now by regulators, utilities and local governments will help determine whether the benefits and costs of this build-out are shared fairly.
segments.tr: 监管机构、电力公司和地方政府眼下做出的决定，将有助于决定这一建设过程的成本和收益是否得到了公平的分摊。

segments.src: For households, the practical takeaway is to pay attention: the rules written in the next few years will shape the monthly bill for a long time.
segments.tr: 对于普通家庭而言，切实的建议是保持关注：未来几年制定的规则将在很长一段时间内塑造你每月的电费账单。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成财务、投资或法律建议。

segments.src: Rates and policies vary by state and utility; consult your local utility or regulator for details that apply to you.*
segments.tr: 电价率和政策因州及电力公司而异；请咨询当地电力公司或监管机构以获取适用于你的具体信息。*

segments.src: ## How this connects to household bills
segments.tr: ## यह घरेलू बिलों से कैसे जुड़ता है

segments.src: - **Fuel and supply costs.** Natural gas prices, aging plant retirements, extreme weather and supply chain constraints on equipment such as transformers also influence rates. Data centers are rarely the only cause of a price change, and attributing a specific bill increase to one source is difficult.
segments.tr: - **ईंधन और आपूर्ति लागत।** प्राकृतिक गैस की कीमतें, पुरानी संयंत्र सेवानिवृत्ति, अत्यधिक मौसम और ट्रांसफार्मर जैसे उपकरणों पर आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की बाधाएं भी दरों को प्रभावित करती हैं। डेटा केंद्र शायद ही कभी मूल्य परिवर्तन का एकमात्र कारण होते हैं, और किसी एक स्रोत के लिए विशिष्ट बिल वृद्धि का श्रेय देना मुश्किल होता है।

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: यहाँ सावधान रहना उचित है।

segments.src: Rates are shaped by many forces, and the size of the data center effect varies widely by region.
segments.tr: दरें कई ताकतों द्वारा आकार लेती हैं, और डेटा केंद्र प्रभाव का आकार क्षेत्र के अनुसार काफी भिन्न होता है।

segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.
segments.tr: कुछ यूटिलिटीज का तर्क है कि बड़े नए ग्राहक अधिक बिक्री पर निश्चित लागत फैलाकर वास्तव में सभी के लिए प्रति यूनिट लागत कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग चेतावनी देते हैं कि यदि अनुमानित मांग साकार नहीं होती है, तो शेष ग्राहकों को अप्रयुक्त संपत्तियों के लिए भुगतान करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate
segments.tr: ## नियामक बहस

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.
segments.tr: राज्य यूटिलिटी आयोग लागत के सवाल का जवाब देने के तरीकों के साथ प्रयोग कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: विभिन्न राज्यों में जिन दृष्टिकोणों पर चर्चा की गई है या जिन्हें अपनाया गया है उनमें शामिल हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.
segments.tr: 1. **बड़े-लोड टैरिफ।** बहुत बड़े ग्राहकों के लिए विशेष दर श्रेणियां, कभी-कभी न्यूनतम अनुबंध लंबाई और न्यूनतम मासिक शुल्क के साथ, ताकि यदि कोई प्रोजेक्ट वापस पैमाना बनाता है तो यूटिलिटी सुरक्षित रहे।

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.
segments.tr: 2. **अग्रिम प्रतिबद्धताएं।** आवश्यकताएं कि डेवलपर्स वित्तीय गारंटी पोस्ट करें या निर्माण शुरू होने से पहले समर्पित ग्रिड उन्नयन के लिए भुगतान करें।

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 3. **इंटरकनेक्शन कतार सुधार।** सट्टा अनुरोधों को बाहर निकालने के लिए कड़े नियम, चूंकि एक ही प्रोजेक्ट को एक साथ कई यूटिलिटीज में जमा किया जा सकता है, जो मांग पूर्वानुमानों को फुला सकता है।

segments.src: 4. **Flexibility programs.** Incentives for data centers to reduce or shift consumption during periods of grid stress, or to bring their own generation or storage.
segments.tr: 4. **लचीलापन कार्यक्रम।** ग्रिड तनाव की अवधि के दौरान खपत को कम करने या स्थानांतरित करने के लिए, या अपने स्वयं के उत्पादन या भंडारण लाने के लिए डेटा केंद्रों के लिए प्रोत्साहन।

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.
segments.tr: उपभोक्ता समर्थक आमतौर उन नियमों का पक्ष लेते हैं जो लागत-कारक से भुगतान करवाते हैं।

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.
segments.tr: डेटा केंद्र ऑपरेटर और कई स्थानीय अधिकारी नौकरियों, कर राजस्व और निवेश की ओर इशारा करते हैं, और तर्क देते हैं कि जब शर्तें स्पष्ट और अनुमानित होती हैं तो वे अपना हिस्सा कवर करने के इच्छुक होते हैं।

segments.src: ## Local politics
segments.tr: ## स्थानीय राजनीति

segments.src: The debate is not only about rates.
segments.tr: बहस केवल दरों के बारे में नहीं है।

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.
segments.tr: उन समुदायों में जहाँ बड़े परिसरों का प्रस्ताव है, निवासी और अधिकारी भूमि उपयोग, शोर, कूलिंग के लिए पानी के उपयोग और नई ट्रांसमिशन लाइनों के दृश्य प्रभाव के बारे में चिंताओं के खिलाफ संपत्ति कर राजस्व और निर्माण नौकरियों का वजन करते हैं।

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: डेटा केंद्र प्रस्तावों पर ज़ोनिंग सुनवाई और काउंटी वोट कुछ क्षेत्रों में अधिक विवादित हो गए हैं, और कई राज्यों ने कर प्रोत्साहनों पर पुनर्विचार किया है जो मूल रूप से इन सुविधाओं को आकर्षित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए थे।

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## नई शक्ति के लिए जोर

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: मांग को पूरा करने के लिए एक ही समाधान के बजाय दृष्टिकोणों के मिश्रण की आवश्यकता होगी:

segments.src: - **Natural gas plants,** which can be built relatively quickly and are being proposed in many regions, though they raise emissions and fuel price questions.
segments.tr: - **प्राकृतिक गैस संयंत्र,** जिन्हें अपेक्षाकृत जल्दी बनाया जा सकता है और कई क्षेत्रों में प्रस्तावित किया जा रहा है, हालांकि वे उत्सर्जन और ईंधन मूल्य के सवाल उठाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **सौर, पवन और बैटरी भंडारण,** जो नई क्षमता वृद्धि का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बनाते हैं लेकिन इंटरकनेक्शन देरी और कुछ मामलों में नीति अनिश्चितता का सामना करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **परमाणु ऊर्जा,** मौजूदा रिएक्टरों के लिए जीवन विस्तार, हाल ही में बंद इकाइयों के पुनः आरंभ और छोटे उन्नत डिजाइनों पर शुरुआती चरण के काम सहित। ये स्थिर आउटपुट प्रदान कर सकते हैं, लेकिन नया निर्माण धीमा और महंगा है।

segments.src: - **Efficiency and demand flexibility,** including more efficient chips and cooling, and scheduling flexible computing tasks for times when power is plentiful.
segments.tr: - **दक्षता और मांग लचीलापन,** अधिक कुशल चिप्स और कूलिंग सहित, और उन समय के लिए लचीले कंप्यूटिंग कार्यों को शेड्यूल करना जब बिजली प्रचुर मात्रा में हो।

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **ग्रिड उन्नयन,** चूंकि प्रचुर मात्रा में उत्पादन भी इसे वितरित करने की ट्रांसमिशन क्षमता के बिना बहुत कम उपयोग का है।

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## पूर्वानुमानों में अनिश्चितता

segments.src: Forecasts for data center demand vary widely.
segments.tr: डेटा केंद्र की मांग के पूर्वानुमान व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होते हैं।

segments.src: Efficiency improvements in AI hardware and software could slow growth, while new applications could accelerate it.
segments.tr: एआई हार्डवेयर और सॉफ्टवेयर में दक्षता में सुधार विकास को धीमा कर सकता है, जबकि नए अनुप्रयोग इसे तेज कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: यूटिलिटीज और नियामक इसलिए कम निर्माण के जोखिम को संतुलित कर रहे हैं, जो विश्वसनीयता को खतरे में डाल सकता है और कीमतें बढ़ा सकता है, अधिक निर्माण के जोखिम के खिलाफ, जो ग्राहकों को ऐसी क्षमता के लिए भुगतान कर सकता है जिसकी उन्हें आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## उपभोक्ता क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **अपना बिल और दर संरचना जांचें।** समझें कि क्या आप एक निश्चित या चर योजना पर हैं, और क्या उपयोग के समय के विकल्प आपकी आदतों में फिट हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **अपने यूटिलिटी आयोग का पालन करें।** दर के मामले और बड़े-लोड कार्यवाही सार्वजनिक हैं, और अधिकांश आयोग ग्राहकों से लिखित टिप्पणियां स्वीकार करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **दक्षता कार्यक्रमों का उपयोग करें।** कई यूटिलिटीज वेदरराइजेशन, कुशल उपकरणों और स्मार्ट थर्मोस्टैट्स के लिए छूट प्रदान करती हैं, जो दर में वृद्धि की भरपाई कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Stay informed locally.** County and city meetings often decide where data centers are sited and what conditions apply.
segments.tr: - **स्थानीय रूप से सूचित रहें।** काउंटी और शहर की बैठकें अक्सर यह तय करती हैं कि डेटा केंद्र कहाँ स्थित हैं और क्या शर्तें लागू होती हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचली रेखा

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.
segments.tr: एआई डेटा केंद्र एकमात्र कारण नहीं हैं कि बिजली की लागत खबर में है, बल्कि वे इस बात के लिए एक केंद्रीय परीक्षण मामला बन गए हैं कि देश नए ऊर्जा बुनियादी ढांचे की योजना कैसे बनाता है, भुगतान करता है और अनुमति देता है।

segments.src: The decisions being made now by regulators, utilities and local governments will help determine whether the benefits and costs of this build-out are shared fairly.
segments.tr: नियामकों, यूटिलिटीज और स्थानीय सरकारों द्वारा अब किए जा रहे निर्णय यह निर्धारित करने में मदद करेंगे कि इस निर्माण के लाभ और लागत निष्पक्ष रूप से साझा किए जाते हैं या नहीं।

segments.src: For households, the practical takeaway is to pay attention: the rules written in the next few years will shape the monthly bill for a long time.
segments.tr: घरों के लिए, व्यावहारिक टेकअवे ध्यान देना है: अगले कुछ वर्षों में लिखे गए नियम लंबे समय तक मासिक बिल को आकार देंगे।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not financial, investment or legal advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य सूचना के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और वित्तीय, निवेश या कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Rates and policies vary by state and utility; consult your local utility or regulator for details that apply to you.*
segments.tr: दरें और नीतियां राज्य और यूटिलिटी के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं; आप पर लागू होने वाले विवरणों के लिए अपने स्थानीय यूटिलिटी या नियामक से परामर्श करें।*

es.title: Alimentando los algoritmos: Por qué los centros de datos de IA están apareciendo en tu factura de electricidad

segments.src: For years, the electric grid in the United States was a quiet story.
segments.tr: Durante años, la red eléctrica en los Estados Unidos fue una historia silenciosa.

segments.src: Demand grew slowly, efficiency gains offset new gadgets, and utilities planned around flat or modestly rising load.
segments.tr: La demanda creció lentamente, las mejoras en eficiencia compensaron los nuevos dispositivos y las empresas de servicios públicos planificaron en torno a una carga plana o moderadamente creciente.

segments.src: That picture is changing.
segments.tr: Ese panorama está cambiando.

segments.src: A surge of large data centers, driven in part by artificial intelligence, is pushing utilities to plan for demand growth on a scale many have not seen in a generation.
segments.tr: Una oleada de grandes centros de datos, impulsada en parte por la inteligencia artificial, está empujando a las empresas de servicios públicos a planificar un crecimiento de la demanda a una escala que muchas no han visto en una generación.

segments.src: The question now moving from industry conferences to public utility hearings is simple: who pays for the power plants and power lines needed to serve them?
segments.tr: La pregunta que ahora pasa de las conferencias de la industria a las audiencias de servicios públicos es simple: ¿quién paga por las centrales eléctricas y las líneas de transmisión necesarias para atenderlos?

segments.src: ## Why data centers are different
segments.tr: ## Por qué los centros de datos son diferentes

segments.src: A conventional office building or factory has a predictable footprint.
segments.tr: Un edificio de oficinas o fábrica convencional tiene una huella predecible.

segments.src: A modern data center campus can require tens or even hundreds of megawatts, and the largest planned projects are discussed in the gigawatt range, comparable to the output of a large power plant.
segments.tr: Un campus moderno de centros de datos puede requerir decenas o incluso cientos de megavatios, y los proyectos planificados más grandes se discuten en el rango de los gigavatios, comparable a la producción de una gran central eléctrica.

segments.src: AI workloads add to this because the specialized chips used to train and run large models draw a lot of power and generate heat that must be removed with cooling systems.
segments.tr: Las cargas de trabajo de IA se suman a esto porque los chips especializados utilizados para entrenar y ejecutar modelos grandes consumen mucha energía y generan calor que debe eliminarse con sistemas de refrigeración.

segments.src: Just as important is the speed.
segments.tr: Tan importante como eso es la velocidad.

segments.src: A data center can be built in a couple of years, while new transmission lines and generating plants often take much longer to plan, permit and construct.
segments.tr: Un centro de datos se puede construir en un par de años, mientras que las nuevas líneas de transmisión y plantas de generación a menudo tardan mucho más en planificarse, permitirse y construirse.

segments.src: That mismatch is at the heart of the current debate.
segments.tr: Esa discrepancia está en el corazón del debate actual.

segments.src: ## How this connects to household bills
segments.tr: ## Cómo se conecta esto con las facturas de los hogares

segments.src: Most households do not pay for data center electricity directly, but they can be affected in several indirect ways:
segments.tr: La mayoría de los hogares no pagan directamente por la electricidad de los centros de datos, pero pueden verse afectados de varias maneras indirectas:

segments.src: - **Infrastructure costs.** Utilities recover the cost of new substations, transmission lines and generation through rates approved by state regulators. If that infrastructure is built largely to serve a few large customers, the question is how much of the cost is assigned to them and how much is spread across all customers.
segments.tr: - **Costos de infraestructura.** Las empresas de servicios públicos recuperan el costo de las nuevas subestaciones, líneas de transmisión y generación a través de tarifas aprobadas por los reguladores estatales. Si esa infraestructura se construye principalmente para servir a unos pocos clientes grandes, la pregunta es cuánto del costo se les asigna a ellos y cuánto se distribuye entre todos los clientes.

segments.src: - **Wholesale market prices.** In regions with organized power markets, higher expected demand can raise the prices that generators receive for capacity, which can flow through to retail bills over time. Several grid operators have reported sharp increases in capacity auction results in recent years, with demand growth cited as one factor among others.
segments.tr: - **Precios del mercado mayorista.** En regiones con mercados de energía organizados, una mayor demanda esperada puede elevar los precios que los generadores reciben por la capacidad, lo que puede repercutir en las facturas minoristas con el tiempo. Varios operadores de la red han informado aumentos pronunciados en los resultados de las subastas de capacidad en los últimos años, citando el crecimiento de la demanda como uno de los factores entre otros.

segments.src: - **Fuel and supply costs.** Natural gas prices, aging plant retirements, extreme weather and supply chain constraints on equipment such as transformers also influence rates. Data centers are rarely the only cause of a price change, and attributing a specific bill increase to one source is difficult.
segments.tr: - **Costos de combustible y suministro.** Los precios del gas natural, el retiro de plantas envejecidas, el clima extremo y las restricciones en la cadena de suministro de equipos como transformadores también influyen en las tarifas. segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: Los enfoques que se han discutido o adoptado en varios estados incluyen:

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: Las empresas de servicios públicos y los reguladores están equilibrando, por lo tanto, el riesgo de construir por debajo de lo necesario, lo que podría amenazar la fiabilidad y elevar los precios, frente al riesgo de construir en exceso, lo que podría dejar a los clientes pagando por una capacidad que no necesitan.

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los consumidores

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **Revisa tu factura y estructura de tarifas.** Comprende si estás en un plan fijo o variable, y si las opciones de uso según el horario podrían adaptarse a tus hábitos.

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **Sigue a tu comisión de servicios públicos.** Los casos de tarifas y los procedimientos de gran carga son públicos, y la mayoría de las comisiones aceptan comentarios por escrito de los clientes.

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **Usa programas de eficiencia.** Muchas empresas de servicios públicos ofrecen reembolsos para climatización, electrodomésticos eficientes y termostatos inteligentes, lo que puede compensar los aumentos de tarifas.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.

segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.
segments.tr: Certains services publics soutiennent que de nouveaux grands clients peuvent en fait réduire les coûts unitaires pour tout le monde en répartissant les coûts fixes sur un plus grand nombre de ventes.

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.
segments.tr: D'autres préviennent que si la demande prévue ne se concrétise pas, les clients restants pourraient se retrouver à payer pour des actifs inutilisés.

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate
segments.tr: ## Le débat réglementaire

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.
segments.tr: Les commissions des services publics des États expérimentent des moyens de répondre à la question des coûts.

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: Les approches qui ont été discutées ou adoptées dans divers États comprennent :

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.
segments.tr: 2. **Engagements initiaux.** Des exigences selon lesquelles les promoteurs affichent des garanties financières ou paient pour des mises à niveau dédiées du réseau avant le début de la construction.

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 3. **Réformes de la file d'attente d'interconnexion.** Des règles plus strictes pour éliminer les demandes spéculatives, car un seul projet peut être soumis à plusieurs services publics à la fois, ce qui peut gonfler les prévisions de demande.

segments.src: 4. **Flexibility programs.** Incentives for data centers to reduce or shift consumption during periods of grid stress, or to bring their own generation or storage.
segments.tr: 4. **Programmes de flexibilité.** Des incitations pour les centres de données à réduire ou à déplacer leur consommation pendant les périodes de stress du réseau, ou à apporter leur propre production ou stockage.

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: Les audiences de zonage et les votes des comtés sur les propositions de centres de données sont devenus plus contestés dans certaines régions, et plusieurs États ont réévalué les incitations fiscales qui avaient été initialement conçues pour attirer ces installations.

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## La poussée pour une nouvelle énergie

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: Répondre à la demande nécessitera probablement un mélange d'approches plutôt qu'une solution unique :

segments.tr: - **Centrales au gaz naturel,** qui peuvent être construites relativement rapidement et sont proposées dans de nombreuses régions, bien qu'elles soulèvent des questions d'émissions et de prix du carburant.

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Solaire, éolien et stockage par batterie,** qui représentent une grande part des ajouts de capacité mais font face à des retards d'interconnexion et, dans certains cas, à une incertitude politique.

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **Énergie nucléaire,** y compris les prolongations de durée de vie des réacteurs existants, les redémarrages d'unités récemment fermées et les travaux à un stade précoce sur des conceptions avancées plus petites. segments.tr: - **Efficacité et flexibilité de la demande,** y compris des puces et un refroidissement plus efficaces, et la planification de tâches informatiques flexibles pour les moments où l'énergie est abondante.

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **Mises à niveau du réseau,** car même une production abondante est de peu d'utilité sans la capacité de transmission pour l'acheminer.

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## Incertitude dans les prévisions

segments.tr: Les prévisions pour la demande des centres de données varient considérablement.

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les consommateurs peuvent faire

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **Suivez votre commission des services publics.** Les dossiers tarifaires et les procédures de grande charge sont publics, et la plupart des commissions acceptent les commentaires écrits des clients.

segments.src: That picture is changing.

segments.src: ## Why data centers are different

segments.src: AI workloads add to this because the specialized chips used to train and run large models draw a lot of power and generate heat that must be removed with cooling systems.

segments.src: For years, the electric grid in the United States was a quiet story.
segments.tr: Selama bertahun-tahun, jaringan listrik di Amerika Serikat merupakan cerita yang tenang.

segments.src: Demand grew slowly, efficiency gains offset new gadgets, and utilities planned around flat or modestly rising load.
segments.tr: Permintaan tumbuh secara perlahan, peningkatan efisiensi mengimbangi gawai baru, dan perusahaan utilitas merencanakan beban yang datar atau meningkat secara moderat.

segments.src: That picture is changing.
segments.tr: Gambaran tersebut sedang berubah.

segments.src: A surge of large data centers, driven in part by artificial intelligence, is pushing utilities to plan for demand growth on a scale many have not seen in a generation.
segments.tr: Lonjakan pusat data besar, yang sebagian didorong oleh kecerdasan buatan, mendorong perusahaan utilitas untuk merencanakan pertumbuhan permintaan pada skala yang belum pernah dilihat oleh banyak orang dalam satu generasi.

segments.src: The question now moving from industry conferences to public utility hearings is simple: who pays for the power plants and power lines needed to serve them?
segments.tr: Pertanyaan yang sekarang beralih dari konferensi industri ke dengar pendapat utilitas publik sangatlah sederhana: siapa yang membayar pembangkit listrik dan jalur transmisi yang diperlukan untuk melayani mereka?

segments.src: ## Why data centers are different
segments.tr: ## Mengapa pusat data berbeda

segments.src: A conventional office building or factory has a predictable footprint.
segments.tr: Gedung perkantoran atau pabrik konvensional memiliki tapak yang dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: A modern data center campus can require tens or even hundreds of megawatts, and the largest planned projects are discussed in the gigawatt range, comparable to the output of a large power plant.
segments.tr: Kampus pusat data modern dapat membutuhkan puluhan atau bahkan ratusan megawatt, dan proyek terbesar yang direncanakan dibahas dalam kisaran gigawatt, sebanding dengan output pembangkit listrik besar.

segments.src: AI workloads add to this because the specialized chips used to train and run large models draw a lot of power and generate heat that must be removed with cooling systems.
segments.tr: Beban kerja AI menambah hal ini karena cip khusus yang digunakan untuk melatih dan menjalankan model besar menarik banyak daya dan menghasilkan panas yang harus dihilangkan dengan sistem pendingin.

segments.src: Just as important is the speed.
segments.tr: Sama pentingnya adalah kecepatan.

segments.src: A data center can be built in a couple of years, while new transmission lines and generating plants often take much longer to plan, permit and construct.
segments.tr: Pusat data dapat dibangun dalam beberapa tahun, sementara jalur transmisi baru dan pembangkit listrik sering kali membutuhkan waktu yang jauh lebih lama untuk direncanakan, mendapatkan izin, dan dibangun.

segments.src: That mismatch is at the heart of the current debate.
segments.tr: Ketidakcocokan tersebut adalah inti dari perdebatan saat ini.

segments.src: ## How this connects to household bills
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana ini terhubung dengan tagihan rumah tangga

segments.src: Most households do not pay for data center electricity directly, but they can be affected in several indirect ways:
segments.tr: Sebagian besar rumah tangga tidak membayar listrik pusat data secara langsung, tetapi mereka dapat terkena dampaknya dalam beberapa cara tidak langsung:

segments.src: - **Infrastructure costs.** Utilities recover the cost of new substations, transmission lines and generation through rates approved by state regulators. If that infrastructure is built largely to serve a few large customers, the question is how much of the cost is assigned to them and how much is spread across all customers.
segments.tr: - **Biaya infrastruktur.** Perusahaan utilitas memulihkan biaya gardu induk, jalur transmisi, dan pembangkit listrik baru melalui tarif yang disetujui oleh regulator negara bagian. Jika infrastruktur tersebut dibangun sebagian besar untuk melayani beberapa pelanggan besar, pertanyaannya adalah berapa banyak biaya yang dibebankan kepada mereka dan berapa banyak yang disebarkan ke semua pelanggan.

segments.src: - **Wholesale market prices.** In regions with organized power markets, higher expected demand can raise the prices that generators receive for capacity, which can flow through to retail bills over time. Several grid operators have reported sharp increases in capacity auction results in recent years, with demand growth cited as one factor among others.
segments.tr: - **Harga pasar grosir.** Di wilayah dengan pasar daya terorganisir, perkiraan permintaan yang lebih tinggi dapat menaikkan harga yang diterima generator untuk kapasitas, yang dapat mengalir ke tagihan eceran dari waktu ke waktu. Beberapa operator jaringan telah melaporkan peningkatan tajam dalam hasil lelang kapasitas dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, dengan pertumbuhan permintaan dikutip sebagai salah satu faktor di antara yang lain.

segments.src: - **Fuel and supply costs.** Natural gas prices, aging plant retirements, extreme weather and supply chain constraints on equipment such as transformers also influence rates. Data centers are rarely the only cause of a price change, and attributing a specific bill increase to one source is difficult.
segments.tr: - **Biaya bahan bakar dan pasokan.** Harga gas alam, pensiun pembangkit yang sudah tua, cuaca ekstrem, dan kendala rantai pasokan pada peralatan seperti transformator juga memengaruhi tarif. Pusat data jarang menjadi satu-satunya penyebab perubahan harga, dan mengaitkan kenaikan tagihan tertentu ke satu sumber adalah hal yang sulit.

segments.src: It is worth being careful here.
segments.tr: Perlu berhati-hati di sini.

segments.src: Rates are shaped by many forces, and the size of the data center effect varies widely by region.
segments.tr: Tarif dibentuk oleh banyak kekuatan, dan ukuran efek pusat data sangat bervariasi menurut wilayah.

segments.src: Some utilities argue that large new customers can actually lower costs per unit for everyone by spreading fixed costs over more sales.
segments.tr: Beberapa perusahaan utilitas berpendapat bahwa pelanggan baru yang besar sebenarnya dapat menurunkan biaya per unit untuk semua orang dengan menyebarkan biaya tetap ke lebih banyak penjualan.

segments.src: Others warn that if projected demand does not materialize, remaining customers could be left paying for unused assets.
segments.tr: Yang lain memperingatkan bahwa jika perkiraan permintaan tidak terwujud, pelanggan yang tersisa dapat dibiarkan membayar aset yang tidak digunakan.

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate
segments.tr: ## Perdebatan regulasi

segments.src: State utility commissions are experimenting with ways to answer the cost question.
segments.tr: Komisi utilitas negara bagian sedang bereksperimen dengan cara-cara untuk menjawab pertanyaan biaya.

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:
segments.tr: Pendekatan yang telah dibahas atau diadopsi di berbagai negara bagian meliputi:

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.
segments.tr: 1. **Tarif beban besar.** Kelas tarif khusus untuk pelanggan sangat besar, terkadang dengan durasi kontrak minimum dan biaya bulanan minimum, sehingga perusahaan utilitas terlindungi jika suatu proyek berkurang.

segments.src: 2. **Upfront commitments.** Requirements that developers post financial guarantees or pay for dedicated grid upgrades before construction begins.
segments.tr: 2. **Komitmen di muka.** Persyaratan agar pengembang memasang jaminan keuangan atau membayar peningkatan jaringan khusus sebelum konstruksi dimulai.

segments.src: 3. **Interconnection queue reforms.** Tighter rules to screen out speculative requests, since a single project may be submitted to several utilities at once, which can inflate demand forecasts.
segments.tr: 3. **Reformasi antrean interkoneksi.** Aturan yang lebih ketat untuk menyaring permintaan spekulatif, karena satu proyek dapat diajukan ke beberapa utilitas sekaligus, yang dapat menggelembungkan perkiraan permintaan.

segments.src: 4. **Flexibility programs.** Incentives for data centers to reduce or shift consumption during periods of grid stress, or to bring their own generation or storage.
segments.tr: 4. **Program fleksibilitas.** Insentif bagi pusat data untuk mengurangi atau mengalihkan konsumsi selama periode tekanan jaringan, atau untuk membawa pembangkit atau penyimpanan mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.
segments.tr: Advokat konsumen umumnya menyukai aturan yang membuat pembuat biaya membayar.

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.
segments.tr: Operator pusat data dan banyak pejabat lokal menunjuk pada pekerjaan, pendapatan pajak, dan investasi, serta berpendapat bahwa mereka bersedia menanggung bagian mereka ketika syaratnya jelas dan dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: ## Local politics
segments.tr: ## Politik lokal

segments.src: The debate is not only about rates.
segments.tr: Perdebatan ini bukan hanya tentang tarif.

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.
segments.tr: Di komunitas di mana kampus besar diusulkan, penduduk dan pejabat menimbang pendapatan pajak properti dan pekerjaan konstruksi terhadap kekhawatiran tentang penggunaan lahan, kebisingan, penggunaan air untuk pendinginan, dan dampak visual dari jalur transmisi baru.

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: Sidang zonasi dan pemungutan suara daerah tentang usulan pusat data menjadi lebih diperebutkan di beberapa wilayah, dan beberapa negara bagian telah mempertimbangkan kembali insentif pajak yang awalnya dirancang untuk menarik fasilitas ini.

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## Dorongan untuk daya baru

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: Memenuhi permintaan kemungkinan akan memerlukan campuran pendekatan daripada satu solusi tunggal:

segments.src: - **Natural gas plants,** which can be built relatively quickly and are being proposed in many regions, though they raise emissions and fuel price questions.
segments.tr: - **Pembangkit gas alam,** yang dapat dibangun dengan relatif cepat dan sedang diusulkan di banyak wilayah, meskipun mereka meningkatkan emisi dan pertanyaan harga bahan bakar.

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **Tenaga surya, angin, dan penyimpanan baterai,** yang membentuk sebagian besar penambahan kapasitas baru tetapi menghadapi penundaan interkoneksi dan, dalam beberapa kasus, ketidakpastian kebijakan.

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **Tenaga nuklir,** termasuk perpanjangan masa pakai untuk reaktor yang ada, dimulainya kembali unit yang baru saja ditutup, dan pekerjaan tahap awal pada desain lanjutan yang lebih kecil. Ini dapat menawarkan output yang stabil, tetapi konstruksi baru berjalan lambat dan mahal.

segments.src: - **Efficiency and demand flexibility,** including more efficient chips and cooling, and scheduling flexible computing tasks for times when power is plentiful.
segments.tr: - **Efisiensi dan fleksibilitas permintaan,** termasuk cip dan pendinginan yang lebih efisien, dan penjadwalan tugas komputasi yang fleksibel untuk waktu ketika daya melimpah.

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **Peningkatan jaringan,** karena bahkan pembangkitan yang melimpah tidak ada gunanya tanpa kapasitas transmisi untuk menyampaikannya.

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## Ketidakpastian dalam perkiraan

segments.src: Forecasts for data center demand vary widely.
segments.tr: Perkiraan untuk permintaan pusat data sangat bervariasi.

segments.src: Efficiency improvements in AI hardware and software could slow growth, while new applications could accelerate it.
segments.tr: Peningkatan efisiensi dalam perangkat keras dan perangkat lunak AI dapat memperlambat pertumbuhan, sementara aplikasi baru dapat mempercepatnya.

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: Perusahaan utilitas dan regulator karena itu menyeimbangkan risiko kekurangan pembangunan, yang dapat mengancam keandalan dan menaikkan harga, terhadap risiko kelebihan pembangunan, yang dapat membuat pelanggan membayar kapasitas yang tidak mereka butuhkan.

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dapat dilakukan konsumen

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **Periksa tagihan dan struktur tarif Anda.** Pahami apakah Anda menggunakan paket tetap atau variabel, dan apakah opsi waktu penggunaan dapat sesuai dengan kebiasaan Anda.

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **Ikuti komisi utilitas Anda.** Kasus tarif dan persidangan beban besar bersifat publik, dan sebagian besar komisi menerima komentar tertulis dari pelanggan.

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan program efisiensi.** Banyak perusahaan utilitas menawarkan rabat untuk cuaca, peralatan efisien, dan termostat pintar, yang dapat mengimbangi kenaikan tarif.

segments.src: - **Stay informed locally.** County and city meetings often decide where data centers are sited and what conditions apply.
segments.tr: - **Tetap mendapat informasi secara lokal.** Pertemuan daerah dan kota sering kali menentukan di mana pusat data ditempatkan dan kondisi apa yang berlaku.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.
segments.tr: Pusat data AI bukan satu-satunya alasan biaya listrik masuk berita, tetapi mereka telah menjadi kasus uji pusat untuk bagaimana negara merencanakan, membayar, dan memberi izin infrastruktur energi baru.

segments.src: The decisions being made now by regulators, utilities and local governments will help determine whether the benefits and costs of this build-out are shared fairly.
segments.tr: Keputusan yang dibuat sekarang oleh regulator, utilitas, dan pemerintah daerah akan membantu menentukan apakah manfaat dan biaya dari pembangunan ini dibagikan secara adil.

segments.src: For households, the practical takeaway is to pay attention: the rules written in the next few years will shape the monthly bill for a long time.
segments.tr: Untuk rumah tangga, pelajaran praktisnya adalah untuk memperhatikan: aturan yang ditulis dalam beberapa tahun ke depan akan membentuk tagihan bulanan untuk waktu yang lama.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, investasi, atau hukum.

segments.tr: Tarif dan kebijakan bervariasi menurut negara bagian dan utilitas; konsultasikan dengan utilitas atau regulator lokal Anda untuk detail yang berlaku untuk Anda.*

segments.src: ## The regulatory debate

segments.src: Approaches that have been discussed or adopted in various states include:

segments.src: 1. **Large-load tariffs.** Special rate classes for very large customers, sometimes with minimum contract lengths and minimum monthly charges, so the utility is protected if a project scales back.
segments.tr: 1. **大口負荷料金。** 非常に大口の顧客向けの特別な料金区分であり、プロジェクトが縮小した場合に電力会社が保護されるよう、最低契約期間や最低月額料金が設定されることがあります。

segments.tr: 4. **柔軟性プログラム。** 送電網に負担がかかる時間帯に消費電力を削減またはシフトさせるインセンティブ、あるいはデータセンターが自前の発電設備や蓄電池を持ち込むためのインセンティブ。

segments.src: Consumer advocates generally favor rules that make the cost-causer pay.
segments.tr: 消費者擁護団体は一般的に、コストを発生させた原因者に支払わせる規則を支持しています。

segments.src: Data center operators and many local officials point to jobs, tax revenue and investment, and argue that they are willing to cover their share when terms are clear and predictable.
segments.tr: データセンターの運営者や多くの地元の役人は、雇用、税収、投資を指摘し、条件が明確で予測可能であれば自分たちの分担分を負担する用意があると主張しています。

segments.src: ## Local politics
segments.tr: ## 地域の政治

segments.src: The debate is not only about rates.
segments.tr: 議論は料金に関するものだけではありません。

segments.src: In communities where large campuses are proposed, residents and officials weigh property tax revenue and construction jobs against concerns about land use, noise, water use for cooling and the visual impact of new transmission lines.
segments.tr: 大規模なキャンパスが計画されている地域社会では、住民や当局が固定資産税の税収や建設雇用と、土地利用、騒音、冷却のための水利用、新しい送電線が視覚的に与える影響への懸念とを比較衡量しています。

segments.src: Zoning hearings and county votes on data center proposals have become more contested in some regions, and several states have reconsidered tax incentives that were originally designed to attract these facilities.
segments.tr: データセンター計画に関するゾーニング公聴会や郡の投票は一部の地域でより論争的になっており、いくつかの州では元々これらの施設を引き付けるために設計された税制優遇措置を再検討しています。

segments.src: ## The push for new power
segments.tr: ## 新たな電力の確保に向けた動き

segments.src: Meeting demand will likely require a mix of approaches rather than a single solution:
segments.tr: 需要を満たすには、単一の解決策ではなく、複数のアプローチの組み合わせが必要になるでしょう。

segments.src: - **Natural gas plants,** which can be built relatively quickly and are being proposed in many regions, though they raise emissions and fuel price questions.
segments.tr: - **天然ガス火力発電所。** 比較的早く建設でき、多くの地域で提案されていますが、排出量や燃料価格に関する疑問が生じます。

segments.src: - **Solar, wind and battery storage,** which make up a large share of new capacity additions but face interconnection delays and, in some cases, policy uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **太陽光、風力、および蓄電池。** 新たな発電容量の追加において大きな割合を占めていますが、系統連系遅延や、場合によっては政策の不確実性に直面しています。

segments.src: - **Nuclear power,** including life extensions for existing reactors, restarts of recently closed units and early-stage work on smaller advanced designs. These can offer steady output, but new construction is slow and costly.
segments.tr: - **原子力発電。** 既存の原子炉の稼働期間延長、最近閉鎖されたユニットの再稼働、そして小規模な次世代炉の初期段階の作業が含まれます。これらは安定した出力を提供できますが、新規建設は遅く、コストがかかります。

segments.src: - **Efficiency and demand flexibility,** including more efficient chips and cooling, and scheduling flexible computing tasks for times when power is plentiful.
segments.tr: - **効率性と需要の柔軟性。** より効率的なチップや冷却システムの導入、および電力供給が豊富な時間帯への柔軟な計算タスクのスケジュール設定が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Grid upgrades,** since even abundant generation is of little use without the transmission capacity to deliver it.
segments.tr: - **送電網のアップグレード。** どれほど豊富な発電量があっても、それを届けるための送電容量がなければほとんど意味がないためです。

segments.src: ## Uncertainty in the forecasts
segments.tr: ## 予測における不確実性

segments.src: Forecasts for data center demand vary widely.
segments.tr: データセンターの需要予測は大きく異なっています。

segments.src: Efficiency improvements in AI hardware and software could slow growth, while new applications could accelerate it.
segments.tr: AIハードウェアおよびソフトウェアの効率化は成長を鈍化させる可能性がある一方、新しいアプリケーションはそれを加速させる可能性があります。

segments.src: Utilities and regulators are therefore balancing the risk of underbuilding, which could threaten reliability and raise prices, against the risk of overbuilding, which could leave customers paying for capacity they do not need.
segments.tr: したがって、電力会社や規制当局は、信頼性を脅かし価格を上昇させる可能性のある過小投資のリスクと、顧客が不要な容量の費用を払い続けることになりかねない過剰投資のリスクとのバランスを取っています。

segments.src: ## What consumers can do
segments.tr: ## 消費者にできること

segments.src: - **Check your bill and rate structure.** Understand whether you are on a fixed or variable plan, and whether time-of-use options could fit your habits.
segments.tr: - **請求書と料金体系の確認。** 固定プランか変動プランのどちらを利用しているか、また時間帯別料金のオプションが自分の生活習慣に合致するかどうかを把握します。

segments.src: - **Follow your utility commission.** Rate cases and large-load proceedings are public, and most commissions accept written comments from customers.
segments.tr: - **電力委員会の動向の追跡。** 料金に関する案件や大口負荷に関する手続きは公開されており、ほとんどの委員会は顧客からの書面による意見を受け付けています。

segments.src: - **Use efficiency programs.** Many utilities offer rebates for weatherization, efficient appliances and smart thermostats, which can offset rate increases.
segments.tr: - **省エネプログラムの活用。** 多くの電力会社が断熱改修、高効率家電、スマートサーモスタットに対してリベート（還元）を提供しており、これらは料金の値上がりを相殺することができます。

segments.src: - **Stay informed locally.** County and city meetings often decide where data centers are sited and what conditions apply.
segments.tr: - **地域情報の把握。** 郡や市の会議では、データセンターがどこに立地し、どのような条件が適用されるかがしばしば決定されます。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: AI data centers are not the only reason electricity costs are in the news, but they have become a central test case for how the country plans, pays for and permits new energy infrastructure.
segments.tr: AIデータセンターは電気代が高騰している唯一の理由ではありませんが、国が新しいエネルギーインフラをどのように計画し、費用を支払い、許可していくのかについての中心的な試金石となっています。

segments.src: The decisions being made now by regulators, utilities and local governments will help determine whether the benefits and costs of this build-out are shared fairly.
segments.tr: 規制当局、電力会社、地方自治体によって現在下されている決定は、このインフラ整備の利益とコストが公平に分かち合われるかどうかを決定づける助けとなります。

segments.src: For households, the practical takeaway is to pay attention: the rules written in the next few years will shape the monthly bill for a long time.
segments.tr: 家庭にとって実用的な教訓は、関心を持ち続けることです。今後数年間に作られる規則が、長期にわたって毎月の電気代を形作るためです。
